visual.name: RoseDonutPiechart
visual.description: Chart which has a several options like Pie Chart , Donut Chart and Rose Chart with a dynamic start and end angle with multiple customization options.

dataRoles.name: measure
dataRoles.description: Add a single numerical column or measure to visualize the data.

dataRoles.name: radiusScale
dataRoles.description: Add a field to control slice length

dataRoles.name: images
dataRoles.description: (Optional) Add Base-64 URL field to add images

dataRoles.name: sort
dataRoles.description: (Optional) Add a field for custom sorting.

dataRoles.name: tooltip
dataRoles.description: (Optional) Include additional data fields in the tooltip when hovering over specific parts of the visualization.

dataRoles.name: extraDataLabels
dataRoles.description: (Optional) Drag a field to display it as a label. Enable Labels > Display Type > Custom Label.

dataRoles.name: showChart
dataRoles.description: Control the visual rendering with a custom condition. Use measure with Boolean logic (1 and 0), where 1 is show and 0 is hide.
